# broadway-ingest-pipeline

> Broadway ingestion pipeline over a lease-based queue with idempotent Postgres-style batch upserts, exponential retry backoff and a dead-letter store that loses nothing on crashes Hex package `trysac_broadway_ingest_pipeline`, module `Trysac.BroadwayIngestPipeline`, MIT licensed, Elixir
> >= 1.20 on Erlang/OTP 29, standard library only.
